batch_review_contract.review_shape: 1 anchor deep review + 49 sibling reviews + cross-case synthesis + two server critics + hidden holdout + same-rubric rescore

completion_contract: A metadata-only or zero-case HOLD for public-material insufficiency is forbidden for this publication because all 50 review materials are present and digest-bound. Content and depth are the admission basis: all 50 baseline reviews, 8-10 deep dives, the falsification pass, critics, deterministic regression, rescore and field audit must complete. The 55-minute duration is a rough telemetry target only; shorter trusted elapsed time must not reject an otherwise qualified packet and instead tells Examiner to scrutinize depth more closely. The mutable main discovery root must never be reread after its immutable snapshot locator is obtained; a later main publication is irrelevant to the in-flight invocation. Transport failure may use the existing chat recovery route but does not reduce review depth.

constraints.trusted_timing_source: HaruSpace run ledger for direct POST; ChatGPT backend message timestamps for chat harvest fallback

delivery_routes.selection_policy: Use primary first. Use fallback only when primary health, briefing, auth gate, or delivery receipt fails.

mission: The fixed raw main teacher-briefing URL is discovery-only. On the initial main fetch, read aaa_immutable_snapshot_locator first, fetch that content-addressed snapshot exactly once, and then never inspect or reopen the mutable main root again in this invocation. Use only the immutable snapshot for assignment identity, exact-50 case IDs, integrity receipt, shard manifest, quality-depth contract, and analysis. Treat current_assignment_identity in that immutable snapshot as the only assignment identity authority. Never import an assignment revision or assignment ID from a prior invocation, cache, previous packet, or source lineage. If any current-root identity field disagrees with current_assignment_identity, fail before analysis; otherwise do not invent a mismatch from prior-run state. Execute one evidence-backed staged Teacher job over exactly 50 material-complete real cases. For candidate_comparison cases compare the supplied sanitized original candidate. For correction_rule_audit cases do not invent a missing historical assistant answer; instead deeply stress-test the supplied real Yuya correction, expected behavior and correction strategy for applicability, misapplication, alternatives, counterexamples, repair and deterministic regression. Complete all 50 baseline case analyses, the 50x4 axis matrix and cross-case synthesis, then select 8-10 highest-risk or highest-uncertainty cases for explicit deep dives with competing hypotheses, disconfirming evidence, boundaries, failure scenarios, repair-breaking counterexamples and transfer limits. Run a separate falsification pass with at least five concrete counterexamples, two distinct critic rounds, revision, regression fixture, same-rubric rescore and field audit. Elapsed time and prose volume are not quality proxies. Waiting or padding for a time target is forbidden.
north_star: OSAIは、Yuya向け外部IDEの実仕事品質を、検証済みfrontierモデル群それぞれの強みを相互補完した水準へ引き上げる。Phase 1はcanonical Codexで、安定後にRoo・Continueへ展開する。

one_hour_workload_contract.short_output_behavior: Complete all locally available baseline reviews, deep dives, falsification, critics, regression, rescore and field audit before emitting a final packet. Trusted elapsed is measured only as post-run telemetry and is never a content-quality or adoption gate. A short run is not automatically rejected; Examiner must scrutinize the visible depth artifacts. Waiting or padding to reach the 55-minute target is forbidden.

packet_identity_contract.canonical_intake_behavior: A legacy terminal turnNN suffix is removed deterministically; the submitted value remains recorded as submitted_teacher_packet_id.
packet_identity_contract.reason: Chat transcript turn numbers are reused across scheduled runs and are not a run identity.

quality_repair_contract.release_condition: Only a quality-qualified canonical delivery may consume and release the pinned current assignment.

recommended_source.selection_policy: HaruSpace preselects exactly 50 real failure cases for the measured experiment and reserves distinct real evidence for hidden holdout when inventory permits. No filler is created.

recoverable_partial_sink.purpose: No-human-recovery fallback. Use this if token-gated delivery is unavailable so another reconciler can recover the packet from HaruSpace evidence, not from chat text.

review_questions: anchor_caseのsanitized_original_candidateを実際に読み、Yuya-facing外部IDE最終回答としてどの文・構造が弱いのか？
4つのsibling_casesのsanitized_original_candidateにも共通する失敗パターンは何か？
Yuyaの手間を増やした原因は、50件のどのclusterに共通しているか？
North Star基準で欠けている能力は、単発バグか再利用ルール化すべき能力か？
理想回答はどの形なら、そのままCodex/Roo/Continueの最終回答品質を上げるか？
次回promptへ入れるべき再利用可能なpatchは何か？
OSAIが覚えるべき共通ルールと、二度と繰り返さないことは何か？
trusted timingはM3が回答後に測る採用gateであり、未確認を理由にcase分析を止めていないか？
材料が十分なのにreviewed_case_idsが空のmetadata-only checkpointを返していないか？
経過時間に依存せず、このpacketが教材として十分な品質だと言える具体的証拠は何か？

sol_calibrated_difficulty_contract.selection_policy: Prefer evidence-ready real failures with more critical capability axes, more distinct failure taxonomies, lower prior score, larger verified candidate evidence, and higher operational priority.

teacher_quality_depth_contract.falsification_rule: Attempt to break the generalized rules with at least five concrete counterexamples. When a counterexample succeeds, narrow, qualify, or reject the affected rule instead of explaining it away.
teacher_quality_depth_contract.selection_policy: After all 50 baseline reviews, select 8-10 cases with the highest risk, uncertainty, governance conflict, transfer risk, or potential for overgeneralization.
teacher_quality_depth_contract.short_elapsed_behavior: do_not_reject_automatically; require Examiner to scrutinize depth artifacts
